content: अनुमन्त्र् €10 <ab>Ā.</ab> To consecrate or accompany with sacred hymns or magical formulas; to dismiss with sacred and auspicious words, dismiss with a blessing; विसृष्टश्च वामदेवानुमन्त्रितोऽश्वः <ls>U. 2</ls>.
